packages.name: FlightPlanning
packages.description: Classes related to the submission and initial processing of flight plan and slot data.

packages.name: CDMCore
packages.description: Core Airport CDM entities representing the flight, turn-round and its evolving operational timeline.

packages.name: Actors
packages.description: External and internal parties participating in the Airport CDM process.

packages.name: Messaging
packages.description: Messages exchanged between the Airport CDM Platform and Network Operations / other systems.

packages.name: Control
packages.description: Control classes orchestrating the milestone processes and platform behaviour.

classes.name: ATCFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS to all involved ATC units.

attributes.name: flightPlanId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the ICAO flight plan.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time as filed in the flight plan.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: Estimated Elapsed Time used to calculate ELDT from ATOT.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO code of the departure aerodrome.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO code of the destination aerodrome.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft as declared in the flight plan; may be used to update flight data.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration as declared.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flight plan is a Repetitive Flight Plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

attributes.name: submissionTime
attributes.description: Time the flight plan was submitted, normally EOBT-3hr or later.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan is expected to correspond to.

attributes.name: slotId
attributes.description: Identifier of the allocated airport slot.

attributes.name: scheduledTime
attributes.description: Scheduled off-block or in-block time associated with the slot.

attributes.name: isCoordinatedAirport
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is a coordinated airport where the outbound flight is already known.

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: Local airport flight data used together with the flight plan and slot to confirm the flight for further processing.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time held locally at the airport.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration held in local airport flight data.

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: First destination data required to feed Network Operations.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An individual arriving or departing flight tracked through its operational milestones on the Airport CDM Platform.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: callsign
attributes.description: Callsign of the flight.

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flight has received a CTOT and is therefore regulated.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flight as updated at each milestone.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time.

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target Off-Block Time provided/updated by the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler.

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target Take-Off Time calculated from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT.

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations for regulated flights.

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: Estimated Landing Time, updated progressively using FUM, ATOT or radar detections.

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: Estimated In-Block Time computed from ELDT and estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: Actual Landing Time, the time the aircraft touches down.

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: Actual In-Block Time, the time the aircraft arrives in-blocks.

attributes.name: acgt
attributes.description: Actual Commencement of Ground handling Time.

attributes.name: asbt
attributes.description: Actual Start Boarding Time.

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time, when the aircraft is ready to taxi.

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Request Time.

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Approval Time.

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual Off-Block Time, when the aircraft pushes back.

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual Take-Off Time.

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by ATC based on traffic load, gate/stand and runway in use.

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-In Time used to compute EIBT.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of the aircraft operating the flight, possibly updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Registration of the aircraft operating the flight.

operations.name: updateEldt
operations.description: Updates the Estimated Landing Time based on FUM messages, ATOT plus estimated elapsed time, or radar detections.

operations.name: updateTobt
operations.description: Records a new or updated Target Off-Block Time entered by the AO/GH or calculated automatically by the platform.

operations.name: computeTtot
operations.description: Calculates TTOT as EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, or TOBT+EXOT if a manual TOBT is available and later, or EOBT+EXOT if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT.

operations.name: checkTtotTolerance
operations.description: Checks whether the TTOT has changed by more than the agreed tolerance, triggering notification to Network Operations.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The turn-round of an aircraft comprising the related arriving and departing flight and the ground handling period between them.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum Turn-round Time used as calculation basis for TOBT/TTOT.

attributes.name: estimatedTurnRoundPeriod
attributes.description: Estimated turn-round period used to calculate TOBT after AIBT/ACGT.

operations.name: linkFlights
operations.description: Associates the arriving and departing flight plans belonging to the same aircraft turn-round.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated for a flight, processes all available information and orchestrates the milestone processes.

attributes.name: platformId
attributes.description: Identifier of the platform instance for the airport.

operations.name: initiateFlight
operations.description: Initiates processing for a flight upon activation of its ATC Flight Plan, setting status to INITIATED.

operations.name: notifyPartners
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of an actual time event (e.g. ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT, ATOT) as it occurs.

operations.name: changeStatus
operations.description: Updates the operational status of a flight following a milestone occurrence.

classes.name: MilestoneProcess
classes.definition: A per-milestone process that checks consistency/feasibility of estimates against the ATC Flight Plan and triggers messaging to Network Operations when tolerances are exceeded.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The number of the milestone this process corresponds to (1-16).

attributes.name: triggerCondition
attributes.description: The event or timestamp that triggers this process (e.g. EOBT-3hr, ALDT, AOBT detection).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: Locally agreed tolerance (e.g. TTOT tolerance) used to decide whether Network Operations must be re-informed.

operations.name: execute
operations.description: Performs the milestone-specific consistency/feasibility check and issues the associated DPI or FUM message and status change if required.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator that submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides estimates (TOBT, ARDT, etc.) throughout the turn-round.

attributes.name: operatorId
attributes.description: Identifier of the Aircraft Operator.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the airline/operator.

operations.name: submitFlightPlan
operations.description: Submits the ICAO flight plan for distribution by IFPS.

operations.name: provideTobt
operations.description: Provides or updates the Target Off-Block Time for the flight.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling company that manages turn-round operations and reports actual times such as ACGT, ASBT and ARDT.

attributes.name: handlerId
attributes.description: Identifier of the Ground Handler.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the ground handling company.

operations.name: reportReady
operations.description: Reports the Actual Ready Time confirming the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back.

classes.name: AtcUnit
classes.definition: An Air Traffic Control unit (tower, ACC/Approach) that provides radar detections, TSAT, ASAT and other ATC-controlled milestone data.

attributes.name: unitId
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATC unit.

attributes.name: unitType
attributes.description: Type of ATC unit, e.g. Tower, ACC, Approach Control.

operations.name: issueTsat
operations.description: Issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time for the flight, sequencing it into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: Grants start-up/push-back clearance recorded as ASAT, checked against TSAT.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function (Network Operations / ETFMS) that issues CTOT for regulated flights and receives DPI and FUM messages.

attributes.name: eventId
attributes.description: Identifier of the network operations instance.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: Issues the Calculated Take-Off Time to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome at EOBT-2hr for regulated flights.

operations.name: receiveDpi
operations.description: Receives a DPI message updating the flight's estimated or actual take-off time.

operations.name: sendFum
operations.description: Sends a Flight Update Message providing updates on the flight's progress once within 3 hours flying time of destination.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message exchanged between the Airport CDM Platform and Network Operations to communicate updated take-off time estimates.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of DPI message, e.g. E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time the DPI message was generated/sent.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Take-off time estimate conveyed in the message.

classes.name: FumMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations to provide updates on the actual progress of an inbound flight.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time the FUM message was generated.

attributes.name: updatedEldt
attributes.description: Updated estimated landing time conveyed by the FUM.

unmodelled: The document notes that for long distance flights the ELDT may differ from the airport slot, a discrepancy rule not attached to a specific class operation (milestone 1).
Attachment 2 referenced for DPI process implementation details is not available in the document text (milestone 1).

The document distinguishes ACARS-derived events (ON/IN/OUT/OFF) as an alternate data source for ALDT/AIBT/AOBT/ATOT but does not define ACARS as a system to be modelled in detail (milestones 6,7,15,16).

Local variable thresholds (e.g. boarding check time before TOBT, TSAT tolerance window) are described as locally agreed parameters without a formal owning class beyond MilestoneProcess.tolerance (milestones 11,13,14).
